status: experimental proof-backed protocol IR with local official-simulator evidence; no final executable theorem
computation: Exact byte-preserving page permutation and replication
target: Restricted Blackhole Metalium: one Tensix, one data-movement issuer, one NoC, one-page circular buffers
proof_scope: A Lean-checked finite state graph covers all modeled issue/DMA-completion interleavings, safe issue, well-founded event paths, and exact terminal output origins for arbitrary immutable page payloads
boundaries: One issuer, one Tensix and NoC; no floating point, compute kernels, multi-core or multi-issuer claim
Exact-copy primitives and disjoint immutable input, output and slot regions are assumptions of the model
Physical scheduling and eventual DMA completion are separate progress assumptions
Metalium C++, compiler, runtime, ELF and silicon correspondence are not formally proved
Static barrier counts and simulator elapsed time are not hardware performance measurements
IR frontend accepts at most 128 instructions; this runtime-argument emitter supports at most 112
